findings.summary: Standardization is computed on the full dataframe before the train/test split, leaking test-set statistics into training and making test AUC optimistic.
Train/serve skew: scaling statistics are computed from the input batch and not persisted, so inference on a single row yields NaN (std is NaN) and on a batch uses different mean/std than training.
A constant column has std of 0, causing division by zero (NaN/inf) that breaks fit.
